items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It sounded like a Monk tune a little bit.

ctx.x: One of those charts was originally written for Kenton. I think “All the Things You Are”. He wrote a handful of dance charts for Kenton in addition to “Young Blood”, “Swing House”, “Wee-Bidda-Bo-Bidda”, “Walking Shoes” and a handful of other things intended to be dance charts and then he re-wrote one or two of them for that date that you were on.
That was nice. They did one of his originals; “Millennium” I think it was called. It sounded like a Monk tune a little bit.
It sounds like “I Mean You”. So over all it was a positive experience for you?
